title: Semantic Map Sharing and Capability-Aware Coverage Planning for AI-Native 6G Robotic Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2609.37666v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Search and Rescue (SAR) operations increasingly deploy heterogeneous teams of aerial and ground robots. However, conventional coverage methods typically do not translate perceived terrain into platform-specific reachability, while continuous image exchange imposes a high communication cost. We propose an edge-centric, semantic-aware coverage planning framework that integrates aerial terrain perception, robot-specific traversability reasoning, and payload-efficient semantic state sharing. Aerial observations are converted into compact semantic grid maps, enabling reachability-constrained area decomposition and capability-aware coverage paths that assign only regions admitted by each robot's capability profile. translated_title: 面向AI原生6G机器人协同的语义地图共享与能力感知覆盖规划
translated_abstract: 搜索与救援（SAR）行动日益部署由空中和地面机器人组成的异构团队。然而，传统的覆盖方法通常无法将感知到的地形转换为特定平台的可达性信息，而持续的图像传输又会带来高昂的通信开销。我们提出了一种以边缘为中心、语义感知的覆盖规划框架，该框架集成了空中地形感知、面向特定机器人的可通行性推理以及低负载的语义状态共享。空中观测被转换为紧凑的语义栅格地图，从而实现受可达性约束的区域分解和能力感知的覆盖路径规划，仅为每台机器人能力档案所允许的区域进行任务分配。由此形成的“感知-共享-规划”闭环将语义修正信息反馈到可通行性推理和重新规划中，构成了一个受AI原生6G网络所设想的AI赋能目标导向通信启发的应用层机制。
tldr: 提出一种以边缘为中心的语义感知覆盖规划框架，将空中感知转换为紧凑语义地图，并结合各机器人能力约束进行区域分解与路径规划，实现搜索救援中异构空中-地面机器人团队的高效协同与低通信开销。
en_tdlr: Proposes an edge-centric, semantic-aware coverage planning framework that converts aerial perception into compact semantic maps and assigns coverage tasks according to each robot's capability profile, enabling efficient low-communication coordination of heterogeneous aerial-ground robot teams in search and rescue.
